mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a sharp contraction in consumer demand, causing a negative S&P 500 return over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing supply chain disruption (indicated by a 3-month decline in industrial production), S&P 500 returns become negative over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate output and higher input costs.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines for 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals rising inflation expectations that prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises above 2.5% YoY, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) decline exceeding 5% in a month signals weak consumer confidence and reduced residential investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST declines by more than 5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a severe labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced manufacturing output and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
